claim: The only bottle size permitted for Vin Jaune.
because: The Arbois cahier des charges (INAO, 2022, ch. I, VIII 3°b) reads the other way round. It reserves the 62 cl clavelin to wines carrying the 'vin jaune' mention; it does not make the clavelin compulsory for vin jaune. Only the Château-Chalon AOP requires that its wine be sold in the 62 cl clavelin alone (INAO product page). Arbois and Côtes du Jura vin jaune is also sold in magnums (150 cl).
fix: The 62 cl clavelin is reserved by law for vin jaune; in Château-Chalon it is the only bottle allowed.
